written: 2026-11-16, committed before the controls' detection rates and the long run are measured (the commit that adds this file is the timestamp)
phase: camera 6a, G22's judged set: an origin on a triangle (a tie in t)
labels: the fix round agent's predictions. Seen before: the failing draw (a tube whose vertex column lies on the ray origin) fails float32 and not float64 on the release tip, on MADDENING 0.4.2 released and on its main; the derived bound on t's rounding held on 24 000 on-surface triangle pairs at 0.26 (float32) and 0.31 (float64) of itself; with the fix the draw passes in both dtypes on both MADDENING versions

operating_point.platform: CPU, the maintainer's laptop (the test file's own runs, one at a time, in the heavy slot)
operating_point.sizes_and_parameters: G22 as written: 40 examples a dtype, one to three closed meshes 25 um to 1 mm, 192 rays; the long run 1500 examples a dtype with the same strategy and settings otherwise

gate_long_run.claim: no draw fails with the tie rule: a miss of the tree (a box test rounding a grazing hit out) would show as a judged ray with fewer crossings, which the 40-example run cannot rule out and 1500 per dtype can show above its own rate

prediction.basis: estimated: one failure in several hundred CI draws on a coincidence the strategy reaches by shrinking to the origin; the other causes in CLAUDE.md's list are excluded by the draws' scales
prediction.why: the tree's slab test is widened by 2 gamma_3 and the watertight test claims each crossing once

gate_long_run.if_wrong: a failure that is not an origin tie is a real finding (a miss, or the oracle): it is classified before anything is changed

gate_tied_fraction.claim: the tie rule leaves out almost no ordinary ray: the fraction of rays tied in an ordinary draw is below 1e-3
gate_tied_fraction.case: the same long run, counted over its draws

prediction.why: a tie needs the origin within about 3 eps of a triangle's plane and inside it: a set of measure near zero for an origin drawn within 5 mm

gate_controls.claim: each planted error is caught every run, in each dtype, and no clean run is flagged
gate_controls.case: tests/sensing/test_mesh_bvh.py::test_the_tree_finds_every_crossing_brute_force_finds with CAMERA_PLANT = dropped-leaf, flipped-winding, shrunk-box, by .github/probe/detection_rate.py

prediction.basis: estimated for shrunk-box (new: a box shrunk to a tenth of its extent loses the crossings of the triangle's aimed rays that do not pass its core); measured-before for the other two (30/30)
prediction.why: every plant is far above rounding

gate_controls.if_wrong: a shrunk-box miss: shrink the box to a smaller part of its extent or aim it at a ray's crossing; the plant is the thing to change, never the plant's detection by a wider band

gate_bits.claim: no program of 6a changes: the fix touches tests only (git diff of the head against the base holds no file under src/), so the compiled programs of the camera are the base's bits
gate_bits.if_wrong: a file under src/ in the diff
